cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Li Huowang test the new cultivation method on himself?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is deeply paranoid and intelligent. He remembers his own trick of tampering with scriptures to escape Danyangzi, so he refuses to trust a manual pried from a monster’s mouth.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of Sun Baolu’s mother’s gold box?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s her dowry, a family heirloom. She gives it as a silent, heavy payment for Li Huowang healing her son, demonstrating the high value placed on such miracles in this brutal world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang order a sheep to be slaughtered for the feast?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a pragmatic decision based on logistics. Liang country has less grassland, so the sheep would starve and lose weight. It makes more sense to eat them now as a strategic resource.
